Bavuma (2/2): [On the bowlers] You've got guys with a strong desire to make it for the team. It's opportunities for certain guys. They're very hungry to make the play for the team. Fortunately, we have a guy like Keshav, who from the spin department, who kind of helps in terms of the bowling overall. We've got a guy like Bjorn Fortuin as well, who's got a wealth of first-class experience. So I think that kind of balances it out. The spinners did an incredible job on the other side. In all, we kind of managed it quite well, the short boundary on this side and the two left-arm spinners on the other side. [On the second ODI and the Pink Day in the next game] Different conditions. We'll see what Wanderers has for us, and of course we're looking forward to the pink day. As per pink, we'll obviously play for the good cause of breast cancer.

168/5 to 297/8 with the bat. 129/1 to 230/10 with the ball. That's how South Africa turned things around in front of a passionate Durban crowd.
